  message : String
  query   : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

  pre  := fun i => i.query ≠ ""
  post := fun i m => m.results = [] ∧ m.message = "No results were found for this search."

  discharge_po [ComputeContract, Spec, ValidateContract]
